_howItWorks: Each group has one 'blurb' that uses every buzzword, marked [[like this]]. The tool shows the whole blurb and highlights the buzzwords the visitor picked. Under it, it shows the 'hears' line for each picked buzzword. Markers match buzzword 'word' values, ignoring capital letters.
questionTemplates: What exactly do you mean by {word}?
What would that actually look like in real life?

groups.label: Health & wellness
groups.who: massage, yoga, counselling, naturopathy, personal training
groups.blurb: At My Business, we take a [[holistic]] approach to your health. Step into a [[relaxing]] space designed to help you [[rejuvenate]] and [[release tension]]. Because [[self-care]] isn't a luxury, it's a necessity. Wherever you are on your [[wellness journey]], we're here to help you find [[balance]].

buzzwords.hears: So… the whole body? Isn't that every massage?
Every spa says that. What's different here?
What does that actually feel like?
I know. I just don't have time.
I'm not on a journey. My back hurts.

groups.example: About twenty minutes in, your shoulders drop half an inch, and you realize you've been holding them up since Tuesday.

steps.answer: Your body finally lets go.
Someone who's been hunched over a laptop all week.
Their shoulders drop half an inch.

groups.label: Coaching & consulting
groups.who: life or business coach, consultant, facilitator
groups.blurb: I help you [[unlock your potential]] and [[transform]] your business. Together we'll get [[clarity]] on what you really want, so you can build a [[purpose-driven]] business that feels [[aligned]]. I [[empower]] my clients to take their lives to the [[next level]].

buzzwords.hears: What's locked? How would I know it's open?
Empower me to do what, exactly?
Everyone says that. I still don't know what it means.
What level am I on now?
Isn't every business driven by something?

groups.example: Last month a client finally said no to a project she'd been dreading for weeks. Two weeks later she booked one she actually wanted, at a higher rate.

steps.answer: Saying yes only to work that fits.
Turning down a project she'd been dreading.
She said no, and booked a better one two weeks later.

groups.label: Creative services
groups.blurb: At My Business, every project starts with your [[creative vision]]. We [[bring your vision to life]] through [[unique]], [[authentic]] storytelling and [[timeless]] imagery that will [[elevate]] your brand. From first call to final delivery, the process is [[seamless]].

buzzwords.hears: I don't have a vision. That's why I'm hiring you.

groups.example: At a family session, the youngest refused to smile, so I asked him for his grumpiest face. The photo on their fridge now is his sister laughing so hard she's falling over.

steps.answer: The moment the family stops posing.
A kid who refused to smile for the camera.
His sister laughing so hard she's falling over.

groups.label: Professional services
groups.who: bookkeeper, accountant, lawyer, virtual assistant, real estate
groups.blurb: At My Business, we're your [[trusted partner]] for growth. Our [[tailored solutions]] [[streamline]] your finances, so you can enjoy [[peace of mind]] all year long. With years of [[expertise]] and a [[results-driven]] approach, we make tax season [[stress-free]].

buzzwords.hears: What would I stop worrying about?

groups.example: Last spring a bakery owner told me she hadn't opened a bank statement in four months. By June she was reading her numbers over coffee every Monday, and she knew she could afford Saturday help.

steps.answer: She knows what she can afford.
A bakery owner deciding whether to hire help.
Reading her numbers over coffee every Monday.

groups.label: Beauty & personal care
groups.blurb: At My Business, it's time to [[pamper]] yourself in a [[luxurious]] space made just for you. Our expert team will [[transform your look]] and leave you with a radiant [[glow]]. Because [[self-love]] matters, and when you [[feel your best]], your [[confidence]] shines.

buzzwords.hears: I don't need pampering. I need my roots done.
That's a lot to ask of a haircut.
I don't want to look like someone else.

groups.example: Before her daughter's wedding, a client told me she hadn't worn her hair down in ten years. At the reception, she took the clip out for the photos.

steps.answer: She stops hiding.
The mother of the bride who always wears her hair up.
Taking the clip out for the photos.

groups.label: Food & hospitality
groups.blurb: At My Business, we serve [[fresh]], [[homemade]] food [[made with love]], using [[locally sourced]] ingredients whenever possible. Pull up a chair in our [[cozy]] space and enjoy something [[delicious]]. With [[something for everyone]] on the menu, there's always a reason to stop by.

buzzwords.hears: Nice. But what does it taste like?

groups.example: Every Saturday at 7 a.m., the same retired couple takes the window table. By the time they sit down, his cinnamon bun is warming and her tea is steeping. No order needed.

steps.answer: You're known here.
The regulars on a Saturday morning.
Their order is ready before they ask.

groups.label: Makers & retail
groups.blurb: At My Business, every piece is [[handcrafted]] with care. Browse our [[curated]] collection of [[one-of-a-kind]] treasures, [[sustainable]] goods and [[unique gifts]] for everyone on your list. [[Quality]] you can feel. [[Shop local]] and support small.

buzzwords.hears: By whom? What does that look like?
Every shop on Etsy says that.
I want to. But why you?

groups.example: A woman bought one of my mugs for her dad, who drinks his coffee on the porch at 5 a.m. A month later she came back for a second one. He'd started inviting the neighbour.

steps.answer: It becomes part of someone's routine.
A dad's 5 a.m. coffee on the porch.
Coming back for a second mug, for the neighbour.

groups.label: Home & trades
groups.blurb: At My Business, we're proud to offer [[reliable]] service and [[quality workmanship]] on every project. [[No job too small]]! Our team is [[fully insured]] and brings [[attention to detail]] to everything we do. Let us [[transform your space]]. [[Satisfaction guaranteed]].

buzzwords.hears: What would bad workmanship look like?
So any job at all? What are you best at?
Guaranteed how? What if I'm not?

groups.example: When we finished her deck, I swept the sawdust out of her flower beds and sent her a photo of the gate latch I'd fixed while I was there. She hadn't asked. She's booked us for the fence in spring.

steps.answer: Leaving it better than we found it.
A deck job.
Sawdust swept out of the flower beds, and a gate latch fixed.

groups.label: Something else
groups.blurb: At My Business, we're [[passionate]] about what we do. We deliver [[high-quality]] results with [[personalized service]] from start to finish. Our [[customer-focused]] team goes [[above and beyond]] with [[innovative]] solutions. Think of us as your [[one-stop shop]].

buzzwords.hears: So you do everything? Then what are you best at?

groups.example: Last week a client emailed at 9 p.m., panicking about a deadline. I answered by 9:15, and the next morning she sent me a photo of the finished project.

steps.answer: Being there when it matters.
A client panicking about a deadline at night.
Answering at 9:15 p.m.
